newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to groove to presidential beat.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to groove to presidential beat.

text.p: Ecuador's flamboyant new President Abdala Bucaram will present his debut compact disk "A Madman in Love" in concert in the port city of Guayaquil on Wednesday, organiser Voltaire Paladines Polo said.
"For the first time in history, our president's voice," concert advertisements announced in local papers on Monday.
The president will be accompanied by Uruguayan backing band Los Iracundos, which means "the enraged".
Bucaram, who took office in August, first presented two of the songs from his disc at a beauty contest in September.
The compact cover features Bucaram wearing his presidential sash and the Ecuadorean flag.
Ticket prices for the concert range from $3 to $15, and include a free presidential cassette or a compact disc, depending on the price of the seat.
Bucaram, who has assumed the nickname "Madman" for his antics, was elected on a populist ticket in July.
